title: Millions fill Buenos Aires streets to welcome Pope Leo XIV
description: The Pope celebrated an outdoor Mass in Argentina's capital, the second stop on a 12-day tour of Latin America, just three weeks after having had surgery for lung cancer.
text: Pope Leo XIV celebrated an outdoor Mass in Buenos Aires, Argentina, the second stop on a 12-day tour of Latin America, only three weeks after having had surgery for lung cancer.
An estimated 2.5 million people filled the streets to welcome him and attend the historic Mass.
